body: 20+ high-performance LLMs with recipes to pretrain, finetune and deploy at scale.
plain_description: **Train, customize, and deploy language models for your business needs.** Use ready-made recipes to adapt models to your data, evaluate results, and serve them in applications.
technical_description: LitGPT is a Python toolkit for pretraining, fine-tuning, evaluating, chatting with, and deploying 20+ LLMs. It provides command-line workflows and configurable YAML training recipes, supports LoRA and QLoRA, and can serve models through a web server with a prediction endpoint. The README describes GPU and TPU support, quantization, and deployment at scale.
title: LitGPT
